ucs.title: [LLM] Gamaredon (Shuckworm/Aqua Blizzard) USB worm LNK → mshta/wscript execution from removable media
ucs.description: Detects Gamaredon's hallmark USB propagation chain — explorer.exe spawning mshta.exe/wscript.exe/cscript.exe/powershell.exe with a command line that points at a .lnk/.hta/.vbs/.wsf on a removable drive (D:–Z:). This is the entry point for Pterodo/GammaLoad/GammaSteel and one of the most actor-distinctive TTPs in Gamaredon's playbook against Ukrainian targets.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_hash) as hash from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name="explorer.exe" Processes.process_name IN ("mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","powershell.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe") Processes.user!="*$" by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rex field=process "(?i)(?<drive_arg>[D-Z]:\\\\[^\"\s]+\.(lnk|hta|vbs|vbe|js|wsf|jse))" | where isnotnull(drive_arg) | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
ucs.kql:
let RemovableDriveArg = @"(?i)\b[D-Z]:\\[^\"\s]+\.(lnk|hta|vbs|vbe|js|wsf|jse)";
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "explorer.exe"
| where FileName in~ ("mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine matches regex RemovableDriveArg
| extend RemovableArtefact = extract(RemovableDriveArg, 0, ProcessCommandLine)
| join kind=leftouter (
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified","FileRenamed")
    | where FolderPath matches regex @"(?i)^[D-Z]:\\"
    | where FileName endswith ".lnk" or FileName endswith ".hta" or FileName endswith ".vbs" or FileName endswith ".wsf"
    | project DropTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DroppedFile = FileName, DroppedFolder = FolderPath, DropperProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName
  ) on DeviceId
| where isnull(DropTime) or DropTime between (Timestamp - 30d .. Timestamp + 1m)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, RemovableArtefact, DroppedFile, DroppedFolder, DropperProcess, InitiatingProcessSHA256, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let RemovableDriveArg = @"(?i)\b[D-Z]:\\[^\"\s]+\.(lnk|hta|vbs|vbe|js|wsf|jse)";
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where Account !endswith "$"
| where ParentProcessName endswith "\\explorer.exe"
| where NewProcessName endswith "\\mshta.exe" or NewProcessName endswith "\\wscript.exe" or NewProcessName endswith "\\cscript.exe" or NewProcessName endswith "\\powershell.exe" or NewProcessName endswith "\\pwsh.exe" or NewProcessName endswith "\\rundll32.exe" or NewProcessName endswith "\\regsvr32.exe"
| where CommandLine matches regex RemovableDriveArg
| extend RemovableArtefact = extract(RemovableDriveArg, 0, CommandLine)
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName, RemovableArtefact, TokenElevationType
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Gamaredon USB Worm LNK Execution via Explorer Spawning Script Host
id: 7a1c6b2e-0a4f-4d5b-8c2a-9e3f4c8e1b22
status: experimental
description: Detects Gamaredon (Primitive Bear / Shuckworm / Aqua Blizzard) USB propagation chain where explorer.exe spawns mshta/wscript/cscript/powershell with a command line referencing a .lnk/.hta/.vbs on a removable drive (D:-Z:).
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0047/
  - https://www.welivesecurity.com/2023/06/14/shuckworm-inside-russia-gamaredon-yearlong-espionage-ukraine/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/18
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1091
  - attack.t1204.001
  - attack.t1218.005
  - attack.t1059.005
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  parent_explorer:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\explorer.exe'
  suspicious_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
  removable_drive_arg:
    CommandLine|re: '(?i)\b[D-Z]:\\[^\"\s]+\.(lnk|hta|vbs|vbe|js|wsf|jse)'
  filter_machine_acct:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: parent_explorer and suspicious_child and removable_drive_arg and not filter_machine_acct
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate user double-click of a script on a USB stick (rare in managed estates)
  - Software-deployment tooling that stages scripts on lettered media
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\explorer.exe OR *\\Explorer.exe OR *\\EXPLORER.EXE) @Image:(*\\mshta.exe OR *\\MSHTA.EXE OR *\\wscript.exe OR *\\WScript.exe OR *\\WSCRIPT.EXE OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\CScript.exe OR *\\CSCRIPT.EXE OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\rundll32.exe OR *\\RunDll32.exe OR *\\regsvr32.exe OR *\\RegSvr32.exe) @CommandLine:(*D\:\\* OR *E\:\\* OR *F\:\\* OR *G\:\\* OR *H\:\\* OR *I\:\\* OR *J\:\\* OR *d\:\\* OR *e\:\\* OR *f\:\\* OR *g\:\\* OR *h\:\\*) @CommandLine:(*.lnk* OR *.LNK* OR *.hta* OR *.HTA* OR *.vbs* OR *.VBS* OR *.wsf* OR *.WSF* OR *.vbe* OR *.VBE*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/^explorer\.exe$/i ImageFileName=/\\(mshta|wscript|cscript|powershell|pwsh|rundll32|regsvr32)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)\b[D-Z]:\\\\[^\"\s]+\.(lnk|hta|vbs|vbe|js|wsf|jse)", field=CommandLine)
| UserName!=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=[count(), min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=lastSeen)])
ucs.rationale: Gamaredon (G0047) has been propagating via USB since at least 2014 and the chain explorer.exe → mshta/wscript/cscript with an LNK/HTA/VBS argument on a non-system drive letter is the diagnostic fingerprint of PteroLNK / GammaLoad first-stage execution — Symantec, ESET, and Cisco Talos have all documented this exact spawn shape against Ukrainian government and military hosts. ucs.title: [LLM] Gamaredon C2 — scheduled-task launched VBS/PowerShell beaconing to .ru / DDNS / Telegram dead-drop infrastructure
ucs.description: Hunts the Pterodo/GammaSteel post-exec persistence + C2 pattern — a schtasks-created VBS/PowerShell loader that subsequently resolves Gamaredon-typical fast-flux .ru subdomains, free DDNS (ddns.net / myftp.org / hopto.org), or Telegram dead-drop domains (t.me / telegra.ph) that Gamaredon uses to resolve dynamic C2 IPs. This is the host-side signature of GammaLoad/GammaSteel staying resident on a compromised Ukrainian endpoint.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name="schtasks.exe" Processes.process="*/create*" (Processes.process="*wscript*" OR Processes.process="*cscript*" OR Processes.process="*mshta*" OR Processes.process="*powershell*" OR Processes.process="*.vbs*" OR Processes.process="*.vbe*" OR Processes.process="*.hta*") Processes.user!="*$" by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process _time | rename Processes.* as * | join type=inner dest [ | tstats summariesonly=true count values(DNS.query) as dns_queries dc(DNS.query) as unique_queries from datamodel=Network_Resolution where (DNS.query="*.ru" OR DNS.query="*.ddns.net" OR DNS.query="*.myftp.org" OR DNS.query="*.hopto.org" OR DNS.query="*.serveftp.com" OR DNS.query="*.bounceme.net" OR DNS.query="t.me" OR DNS.query="*.telegra.ph" OR DNS.query="telegra.ph") DNS.src!="" by DNS.src DNS.query | rename DNS.src as dest | stats values(dns_queries) as suspicious_domains sum(count) as resolution_count by dest ] | table _time, dest, user, process, suspicious_domains, resolution_count
ucs.kql:
let SuspectTlds = dynamic([".ru",".ddns.net",".myftp.org",".hopto.org",".serveftp.com",".bounceme.net",".sytes.net",".serveblog.net"]);
let TelegramDeaddrops = dynamic(["t.me","telegra.ph","telegram.org"]);
let SchedTask = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where FileName =~ "schtasks.exe"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has "/create"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("wscript","cscript","mshta","powershell","pwsh",".vbs",".vbe",".hta",".js",".wsf")
    | project TaskTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, TaskCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
let SuspectDns = DeviceEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where ActionType == "DnsQueryResponse"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","rundll32.exe")
    | extend QName = tolower(tostring(parse_json(AdditionalFields).QueryName))
    | where isnotempty(QName)
    | where QName endswith ".ru"
        or QName has_any (SuspectTlds)
        or QName in~ (TelegramDeaddrops)
        or QName endswith ".telegra.ph"
    | project DnsTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, QName, ResolverImage = InitiatingProcessFileName, ResolverCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
SchedTask
| join kind=inner SuspectDns on DeviceId
| where DnsTime between (TaskTime .. TaskTime + 24h)
| extend DwellMinutes = datetime_diff('minute', DnsTime, TaskTime)
| summarize SuspectDomains = make_set(QName, 25), Resolutions = count(), FirstDns = min(DnsTime), LastDns = max(DnsTime)
          by DeviceName, AccountName, TaskCmd, ResolverImage, TaskTime
| where array_length(SuspectDomains) >= 1
| order by TaskTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let SuspectTlds = dynamic([".ddns.net",".myftp.org",".hopto.org",".serveftp.com",".bounceme.net",".sytes.net",".serveblog.net"]);
let TelegramDeaddrops = dynamic(["t.me","telegra.ph","telegram.org"]);
let SchedTask = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where Account !endswith "$"
    | where NewProcessName endswith "\\schtasks.exe"
    | where CommandLine has "/create"
    | where CommandLine has_any ("wscript","cscript","mshta","powershell","pwsh",".vbs",".vbe",".hta",".js",".wsf")
    | project TaskTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, Account, TaskCmd = CommandLine;
let SuspectDns = DnsEvents
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | extend QName = tolower(Name)
    | where QName endswith ".ru"
        or QName has_any (SuspectTlds)
        or QName in~ (TelegramDeaddrops)
        or QName endswith ".telegra.ph"
    | project DnsTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, QName, ClientIP;
SchedTask
| join kind=inner SuspectDns on Computer
| where DnsTime between (TaskTime .. TaskTime + 24h)
| summarize SuspectDomains = make_set(QName, 25), Resolutions = count(), FirstDns = min(DnsTime), LastDns = max(DnsTime)
          by Computer, Account, TaskCmd, TaskTime
| where array_length(SuspectDomains) >= 1
| order by TaskTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon ((@EventID:1 @Image:(*\\schtasks.exe OR *\\Schtasks.exe OR *\\SCHTASKS.EXE) @CommandLine:(*\/create* OR *\/CREATE*) @CommandLine:(*wscript* OR *WScript* OR *WSCRIPT* OR *cscript* OR *CSCRIPT* OR *mshta* OR *MSHTA* OR *powershell* OR *PowerShell* OR *POWERSHELL* OR *.vbs* OR *.VBS* OR *.hta* OR *.HTA*)) OR (@EventID:22 @Image:(*\\wscript.exe OR *\\WSCRIPT.EXE OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\CSCRIPT.EXE OR *\\mshta.exe OR *\\MSHTA.EXE OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE) @QueryName:(*.ru OR *.RU OR *.ddns.net OR *.DDNS.NET OR *.myftp.org OR *.hopto.org OR *.serveftp.com OR *.bounceme.net OR *.sytes.net OR t.me OR telegra.ph OR *.telegra.ph)))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
(#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\schtasks\.exe$/i CommandLine=/(?i)\/create\b/ CommandLine=/(?i)(wscript|cscript|mshta|powershell|pwsh|\.vbs|\.vbe|\.hta|\.wsf|\.js)/ UserName!=/\$$/)
| join({#event_simpleName=DnsRequest ContextImageFileName=/\\(wscript|cscript|mshta|powershell|pwsh|rundll32)\.exe$/i DomainName=/(?i)(\.ru$|\.ddns\.net$|\.myftp\.org$|\.hopto\.org$|\.serveftp\.com$|\.bounceme\.net$|\.sytes\.net$|^t\.me$|telegra\.ph$)/}, field=aid, include=[DomainName, ContextImageFileName])
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, CommandLine, ContextImageFileName], function=[count(), collect([DomainName]), min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=lastSeen)])
